notes.title: What's Next?
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! Thanks for checking out Lecture Me Later. During the Steam Next Fest I participated in, I got a lot of interest from many different countries, which helped me continue thinking about plans for the future.[/p][p]So I'll share with you all some of my future plans here. Nothing is set in stone, but these are my plans.[/p][p][u][b]**I just want to start off by saying that this is [i]only[/i] a typical [/b][/u][b][i][u]GxB[/u][/i][/b][b][u] kind of otome game, and I have no plans to change this and expand from that with pronoun options. Thank you for understanding.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Future plans for 2025-2026/27[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Update Vahn's model and animations for the final time, make him closer resemble a [u]Filipino male[/u], give him better/more movement and expressions, etc. (for demo update and beyond)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix the game's FPS!! [/b](for me personally, it runs at around 12-20 FPS, which is terrible!) (for demo update and beyond)[/p][/*][*][p]Include CGs[/p][/*][*][p]To be able to have engaging CGs, you'll be given the option to choose between a few preset MC options (she'll have a Live2D model in the bottom left corner, and will appear in CGs.) (also this one isn't set in stone. [i][b]Comment below your interest level in this, scale of 1-5[/b][/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Localization (game text)[/p][p]I've seen the most interest  in the game from the following countries: China, Brazil, Japan, and Russia. [/p][p]Some of the future updates to the demo will include text options in: [b]Chinese (Traditional & Simplified), Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Russian[/b], and I'd also like to include [b]Filipino/Tagalog[/b] and [b]Cebuano[/b] since [u]Vahn is Filipino[/u].[/p][p][i]The future demo update with these languages will only include machine translated text. Hiring folks for localization will come later (see below.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Localization (voice acting)[/p][p]As of now, my plans for the full game's release will be to have voice acting in [b]English, Tagalog[/b] and Possibly [b]Japanese[/b]. (Comment below if you want me to consider other languages for voice.)[/p][/*][*][p]DLC[/p][p]I have an idea for a short DLC that I won't go too much into, but you'll be able to romance ??? in it. Also, the localization (voice and text) will apply to this too.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crowdfunding/ General Funding[/b][/p][p]I don't plan on running a large Kickstarter campaign. Instead, I'll follow the examples of a couple other fellow indies and use [b]Ko-fi[/b] goals instead. I'll also start [b]livestreaming[/b] some of my processes, and I also have a [b]Patreon[/b]. It is mainly for my reaction content, but I do have a [u]Producer[/u] tier over there where you'd get access to all content I make, as well as have voting power AND your name will appear in the credits of any upcoming finished game as long as your subscribed for a certain period of time and production is still active.[/p][p]My plan is to [u]start[/u] working towards these funding goals by [b]September or October 2025[/b], and have all the funding needed to pay voice actors, language experts/editors/scriptwriters, as well as myself (misc. production costs, Marketing, partially keeping a roof over my head,) between [b]January 2026 and May 2026[/b]. Once I've researched more and speak to people about rates, I'll have an estimated goal to work towards.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u][b]Release[/b][/u][/p][p]I can't give a clear answer for this. I'd expect, with the added workload of matching voices to lines, ensuring all localized text is in the proper places, and creating more Live2D models and now illustrations, it would take me to [b]last quarter 2026[/b], or [b]first quarter 2027[/b], but this is just [i]speculation[/i].[/p][p][u][b]Cost[/b][/u][/p][p][i]What will the full release and subsequent DLC cost?[/i][/p][p]Base game, [u]if everything falls flat[/u] and I can't get enough funding for voice actors, and I exclude customization: [b]$7.99 (sale price $4.99) (these prices may get localized to better suit different region's currency)[/b][/p][p][u]Full base game[/u]: [b]$11.99 ($9.99 sale price)[/b] [b](these prices may get localized to better suit different region's currency)[/b][/p][p][u]DLC[/u] (for ??? and maybe even Vahn): [b]$5.99 (sale price $3.99) (these prices may get localized to better suit different region's currency)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]That's all I have for you today. Thanks for checking out my future plans. Comment below if you have any questions/suggestions/concerns/interest and I'll check them out.[/p][p]See you next time![/p][p][i]Lehxra[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: May 2025 Patch Note - Minor Update
notes.content:
The demo has been updated to version 0.4 as of 5/27/2025.
The changes are as follows:

[u][b]Changelog[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Created a new graphic used in marketing and main menu
[*] small UI changes
[*] minor lighting changes
[*] Modified poly count of some assets, resulting in smaller file size
[*] Replacement of environmental assets
[/list]
